title: Library init, wasm loading, licensing, bundle/tree-shaking, Builder
focus: Startup and script-load cost: wasm fetch/compile/instantiate (streaming? caching? SIMD probe?), module caching, license checks (network calls, timers, per-frame checks), telemetry, eager registration of all types (Builder/register) defeating tree-shaking, package.json exports/sideEffects, emscripten glue (_glue-pretty/scichart.js: memory growth, updateMemoryViews, embind call overhead, string marshalling).

title: 2D surface, renderer, render context, drawing caches, helpers
focus: Per-frame orchestration on the JS side: SciChartSurface/SciChartSurfaceBase/SciChartRenderer render pass, sub-surfaces, overview, RenderSurface, WebGlRenderContext2D, pen/brush/texture caches (cache keys, eviction, per-frame allocation), NativeObject/drawLabel helpers, watermark, copyCanvasUtils (2D canvas copy per frame), heatmap legend.

title: Renderable series classes (base, stacked collections, column/rect/ohlc/band/heatmap/contours/...)
focus: Per-frame and per-data-change work in BaseRenderableSeries and the concrete series: getXRange/getYRange computations, stacked collections (per-frame accumulation arrays), palette handling, resampling triggers, property setters invalidating, per-frame allocations, wasm vector creation per frame.

title: Drawing providers, render-data transforms, point markers, polar drawing providers
focus: The per-frame draw path per series: DrawingProviders (line, mountain, column, band, heatmap, ...), palette provider evaluation per point, render data transforms (spline etc.), point marker texture creation, polar drawing providers. Look for per-frame allocations of native vectors/pens/brushes, per-point JS loops calling into wasm, repeated texture uploads, missing caching.

title: Data labels, hit testing, series animations, polar series, rollover helpers
focus: Data label providers (per-point text layout per frame, measureText, string formatting), hit-test providers (per pointer event cost: linear scans vs binary search, allocations), series animations (per-frame allocation/copies of data), polar series.

title: Axes, label providers, tick providers, coordinate calculators, texture manager, text utils
focus: Per-frame axis work: tick calculation, label formatting (Intl/toFixed/toLocaleString per label per frame), label caching keys and eviction, text-to-texture (canvas measureText/fillText, getImageData readback, texture upload), coordinate calculator creation per frame, DateTime formatting.

title: Annotations (SVG/DOM/render-context), adorners, rubber band, legends
focus: DOM/SVG work: per-frame SVG attribute writes, innerHTML rebuilds, layout reads (getBBox/getBoundingClientRect/clientWidth) interleaved with writes, tooltip/legend DOM rebuild per mouse move or per frame, listener teardown on delete.

title: Data series model (XyDataSeries & co), point series, data distribution
focus: Ingestion and per-frame data access: append/appendRange/insert/remove/update, JS<->wasm copies (vectorToArray), metadata arrays, fifo, data range computation (getXRange/getWindowedYRange: full scans per frame?), dataChanged events, isSorted/containsNaN detection cost, per-call allocations.

title: Filters, chart data, resamplers, remaining utils
focus: Filters (moving average, ratio, scale/offset... recompute whole series on each change?), ChartData, resampling parameter computation, utils (parseColor caching, performance helpers, pointUtil, translate, WasmMemoryDebugHelper/MemoryUsageHelper overhead when not enabled).

title: Chart modifiers (2D + polar) and mouse/touch input management
focus: Input hot paths: pointermove/wheel handlers (layout reads like getBoundingClientRect per event, no rAF coalescing, synchronous redraw per event), rollover/cursor/tooltip per move (hit test all series), zoom/pan modifiers, modifier groups, passive listeners, listener cleanup.

title: Layout managers, core primitives, observable collections, animations, themes, types
focus: Per-frame layout measurement (axis layout strategies), ObservableArray/EventHandler overhead, Rect/NumberRange allocation per frame, animation engine (timers vs rAF), theme application, enums/types with runtime cost.

title: Pie/donut surface, 3D surface, 3D visuals/axes/primitives/annotations
focus: Pie surface (SVG/DOM per frame?), SciChart3DSurface render loop, camera updates, 3D axis label/tick text, primitives (meshes/buffers recreated per frame), 3D annotations.

title: 3D renderable series, 3D data series, 3D point markers, 3D modifiers
focus: 3D data ingestion and per-frame scene updates: point cloud / surface mesh series copying data each frame, 3D hit testing per mouse move, orbit/zoom modifiers per event, point marker textures.

title: Cross-cutting trace: one frame end to end
focus: Follow ONE rendered frame end to end across files: what schedules a redraw (invalidateElement / requestAnimationFrame / render loop in createMaster/SciChartSurfaceBase/SciChartRenderer), how many invalidations coalesce, what runs per frame for a surface with N series, M axes, K annotations (allocations, DOM reads/writes, canvas resize checks, devicePixelRatio reads, copy from shared WebGL canvas to per-chart 2D canvas in create() mode via drawImage), and whether the loop stops when nothing changed, when the tab is hidden, or when the chart is off-screen. Also multi-surface: does one surface invalidation redraw all surfaces sharing the master context?
files: (whole esm tree; start at esm/Charting/Visuals/createMaster.js, SciChartSurfaceBase.js, SciChartSurface.js, esm/Charting/Services/SciChartRenderer.js)

title: Cross-cutting trace: data update path and surface lifecycle
focus: (a) Follow one streaming update end to end: dataSeries.appendRange(xs, ys) with JS arrays or Float64Array → JS->wasm copy → dataChanged event fan-out → invalidate → range recalculation (autorange: getXRange/getWindowedYRange full scans?) → resampling → render-data → GPU upload; count full-array passes per update and per frame. (b) Follow surface/series lifecycle: create → delete(): which listeners (window/document resize, ResizeObserver, IntersectionObserver, visibilitychange, mouse), timers, global registries/caches (label caches, texture caches, wasm objects) survive delete() and retain memory; repeated create/delete cycles growth.
files: (whole esm tree; start at esm/Charting/Model/BaseDataSeries.js, XyDataSeries.js, SciChartSurfaceBase.js delete(), esm/Core/DeletableEntity.js)
